title: needs-human-decision flag derived and sorted first in letters and WakeReport
action: Per a7e6f237 (plan S3). Derive a needs-human-decision yes/no flag deterministically — yes when a queued item is waiting-on kind gate or question, or a mailbox row of kind escalation, urgent, or advisor-nudge; no otherwise. Render yes-flagged items FIRST, stable order within each group: in the human-mailbox letter renderer (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/mailbox.rs, letter assembly around letter_filename/letter_path/list_letter_files ~:176-187) and in the WakeReport assembly inside packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/supervisor.rs (the report window region). A malformed queue row derives flag=no and still renders — the renderer never panics on data. TDD inline tests: sort order asserted, derivation per kind, malformed-row fallback.

truths: A letter lists yes-flagged items before all others, stable within groups
The WakeReport applies the same order
A malformed queue row renders with flag=no instead of panicking
